features.headline: Nvidia −14% as SEC said to probe its accounting
features.summary: Shares fall to $125.53, worst day since Jan 2025, after Reuters reports SEC staff are examining accounting issues; chip index drops ~10%.

features.headline: Anthropic falls 9% on day two; IPO grows to $93.5bn
features.summary: Shares slide to ~$89 from $97.17 close; underwriters take the full greenshoe, making it the largest IPO ever.

features.headline: Asia rout: Nikkei −4.8%, Kospi −5.2%, Taiex sinks
features.summary: Taiex heads for its worst week since 1990; MSCI Asia falls 2.5% in a day on the AI sell-off.

features.headline: Bitcoin falls below $60,000, first time since July
features.summary: Touches ~$57,700 intraday, down ~13% in a week; US spot ETFs see $582m of outflows in a day.

features.headline: Gold heads for worst week in 8 months
features.summary: Spot falls to ~$3,514–3,586, lowest since Sept 2025; Fed hike odds for December near 93–99%.

features.headline: Israeli strikes kill six in Gaza despite ceasefire
features.summary: Air and drone strikes hit central Gaza camps; 1,600+ Palestinians killed since the October truce began.

features.headline: Saudi-led strikes hit Houthi targets; blasts in Riyadh
features.summary: Coalition hits Hodeidah port and Sanaa; two blasts heard in Riyadh overnight as defences intercept missiles.

features.headline: Peru quake M6.8 shakes Lima; no casualties
features.summary: Quake strikes at 19:09 local, felt strongly in Lima; no deaths or major damage in early checks.

features.headline: Denmark expels Russian attaché over rapper murder plot
features.summary: Intelligence says Russia plotted to kill rapper Kyivstoner; two Danes charged with attempted murder.

features.headline: Akvan aftermath: Odisha escapes with no deaths
features.summary: 372,000 evacuated, 209 mm rain in Patrapur; storm weakens to a depression, no flood threat.

kicker: Wall Street rout · Russia blitz, debris in Poland · COP31 overtime · Bitcoin below $60k

leads.headline: Wall Street rout: S&P and Dow enter correction
leads.summary: S&P −3.7% to 6,910, Nasdaq −5.3% to 22,618 — now negative for 2026; S&P and Dow both 10%+ below records, in correction; worst week since 2020.

leads.headline: Russia's missile blitz hits Ukraine; debris lands in Poland
leads.summary: 110+ missiles and ~400 drones hit Ukraine; 8–9 killed, Kyiv bridges damaged, nuclear plants cut power; two missiles and a drone land in Poland — NATO calls it a 'grave violation'.

leads.headline: COP31 spills into overtime with no deal
leads.summary: Climate talks miss their Friday deadline as ~200 nations split over fossil fuels; Thursday draft drops all fossil-fuel mentions and the $120bn adaptation target; third draft promised Saturday morning.
